key.name: carousel-dir
key.description: Folder scanned for wallpaper images (*.png, *.jpg, *.jpeg). When empty, Wallfred falls back to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers.

key.name: interval-minutes
key.description: How often the wallpaper changes when rotation is enabled. Constrained to whole minutes, 1 through 60.

key.name: rotate-enabled
key.description: When true, a GLib timer changes the wallpaper every interval-minutes. When false, only manual picks apply.

key.name: shuffle
key.description: Random order, avoiding an immediate repeat of the current wallpaper, when true; alphabetical by filename when false.

key.name: usage-stats
key.description: Maps each wallpaper file path to how many times it has been explicitly chosen (clicked). Automatic rotations do not count.

key.name: usage-last
key.description: Maps each wallpaper file path to the Unix time (seconds) it was last chosen. Used to break ties when ranking by frequency.
